as_told.title: Missile defense devised to take down UFOs

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there is a direct link between a set of 1962 tests called Bluegill Triple Prime and the Strategic Defense Initiative, a space weapons plan of the 1980s under President Ronald Reagan, nicknamed Star Wars, and he ties the physicist Edward Teller in. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb argues that parts of that plan, a program on lethality and target hardening and another on particle beam weapons, were meant to use space-based microwave weapons to shoot down UFOs. If true, it would mean a huge public defence effort was partly aimed at unknown craft.
